newsitem.title: USA: Benihana says to buy Rudy's Restaurant.
newsitem.headline: Benihana says to buy Rudy's Restaurant.

text.p: Benihana, the teppanyaki-style Japanese restaurant chain, said Wednesday that it will pay $20 million, or $5 for Rudy's Restaurant Group Inc. Rudy's stock is currently halted on the Nasdaq.

Benihana said the acquisition of Rudy's, which operates 9 teppanyaki restaurants in Florida, Ohio, Michigan, Minnesota, Pennsylvania, and Washington D.C., will be immediately accretive to its net sales and current year's operations.
The $20 million purchase price represents not only purchase of Rudy's common stock, but also severance and non-competition payment's to Rudy's personnel, a Benihana statement said.
The company said Rudy's net sales for its fiscal year ending 1996 were $14.6 million and pre-tax earnings of $1.9 million.
Benihana says it expects the deal to close in the fall of this year.
